saints.name: St. Gatian of Tours
saints.title: First Bishop of Tours
saints.shortBlurb: One of the missionary bishops sent from Rome into Gaul, who planted the faith at Tours amid persecution…
biography: According to St. Gregory of Tours, Gatian was one of seven bishops sent from Rome about the middle of the third century to preach the Gospel in Gaul. He established himself at Tours, where he ministered to a small and often hidden flock through years of pagan hostility, gathering his people in secret to celebrate the sacred mysteries.
He labored there some fifty years and died about the year 301, the first bishop of a see later made illustrious by St. Martin. He was buried in the Christian cemetery of the city.
saints.knownFor: The apostle and first bishop of Tours.

sources.text: The Roman Martyrology (1914 English ed.; public domain)
